chunks: The virtuous and beautiful women from the women of the people of this world are more beautiful than the wide-eyed houris, and there is no harm in a man looking at his wife while she is unclothed.

key_terms.الْخَيْرَاتُ: virtuous women; those characterized by goodness
key_terms.لاَ بَأْسَ: there is no harm; no objection or prohibition

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a husband to look at his wife while she is unclothed, and how do righteous worldly women compare to the houris?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the righteous and beautiful women of the people of this world surpass the houris in beauty. It also gives a legal ruling that there is no harm in a man looking at his wife while she is unclothed.
